About these 17 rides

They ride on 6 days of the week; Tuesday and Saturday have the most, 6 each; only Friday has none. The earliest start is Wednesday Morning Velo at 6:30 am; the latest is Denver Cruiser Ride at 7:00 pm. After work, 8 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 11 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 6. There are 2 rides made for LGBTQ+ riders, 3 for women, trans and femme riders, 1 for BIPOC riders and 1 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
